verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions an in-app universal search bar. The closest match is the official MCP server, which lets an external AI assistant query transactions with filters, list and filter cards, manage vendors, and pay a vendor from one conversational interface. That approximates cross-entity lookup that leads into payment, but only through a separate agent tool, not native in-product search. Missing for 10: a documented in-app universal search spanning transactions, vendors and cards; a direct search-to-payment flow in the UI; any hands-on or independent corroboration.
